look.goal: See which computers are waiting to be paired (lan_discover_nodes). If one is, ask the owner which to pair (ask_owner); only after the owner picked it, start the pairing offer (pair_offer_start). You never pick a computer for the owner.

offered.reason: a pairing code was made for the computer the owner picked; the key exchange and the owner's approval follow in code

nobody_waiting.reason: no computer is waiting; the owner is told how to make one appear (`mas join` on the other computer)
